item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.117
item.description:
Release v1.0.117 adds sandbox CA certificate trust support, MCP/tool permission fixes, and several session/resume reliability improvements. It also fixes terminal/UI issues, permission prompt behavior, hooks/process handling, and model picker warnings.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.114
item.description:
Release 1.0.114 contains fixes and changes. No additional details are provided in the release note body.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Assisted Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Application Code Migration
item.description:
A preview plugin adds AI-assisted conversion of application code from Oracle to PostgreSQL. It can be used through GitHub Copilot CLI or Visual Studio Code to help applications work with Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI now supports Microsoft Entra authentication in public preview. Users can sign in with a Microsoft Entra account to authenticate to a linked GitHub Enterprise Managed User.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.113
item.description:
Version 1.0.113 adds a managed setting, features.browserUse, that allows administrators to disable the built-in Browser Use feature. The setting can also affect running sessions.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: security: The risks of device code authentication for AI coding agents
item.description:
Microsoft says lab research shows device code phishing can apply to any device-flow client, and demonstrates the risk using GitHub Copilot CLI as an example.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.109
item.description:
Release 1.0.109 focuses on CLI/IDE session reliability, settings/help text corrections, and permission/model handling fixes. It also adds IPv4/IPv6 CIDR support for sandbox host allow/deny rules and support for Claude Fable 5.2 in the model picker.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.106
item.description:
Release v1.0.106 adds inline image support in Rex terminals, a new /code command, unified /settings/dashboard navigation, and several session/agent management improvements. It also includes many fixes for Windows, MCP/LSP/sandbox behavior, prompt editing, terminal rendering, and help/docs accuracy.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.104
item.description:
Version 1.0.104 changes session startup and fallback behavior for Auto/Autopilot modes, updates how background-task waiting is handled, and makes Assisted Permissions available without experimental mode.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.98
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.98 adds Gemini 4 Argon support, improves command hook reliability, and fixes several session and UI/input issues.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: Discover local models in GitHub Copilot CLI
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI version 1.0.94-0 adds a /model command so you can discover supported local models from within the CLI instead of leaving your workflow.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Faster C++ code intelligence with whole codebase indexing
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI now supports whole-codebase indexing for C++ repositories, improving code intelligence performance. The change is aimed at large C++ codebases with many interconnected files.

  • Source: GitHub
